description: Check whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and Gemini cite a domain when asked the given questions. Send 1 to 5 realistic buyer questions (each at least 5 characters). Returns, per AI, how many questions cited the domain. Each check calls paid AI APIs, so the limit is 5 checks per 30 minutes per IP.

domain.description: The domain to look for in AI answers, e.g. example.com.

queries.description: 1 to 5 buyer questions to ask each AI, e.g. "best crm for dentists". Each at least 5 characters.

name: check_ai_citations
title: Check AI citations
